name: ws-marketplace
description: WS Agency internal plugins, agents, and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: docs-agent
plugins.description: Dual-track documentation suite with unified /ws-docs entry (discovery, init, audit, catchup, repair, write, adr, architecture, contributing, changelog, release-notes, explain, publish, pull-back), hub-aware product-docs routing, Outline sync via outline-sync.py, opt-in PreToolUse/Stop hooks, and background subagent dispatch

plugins.name: ws-commit-commands
plugins.description: Jira-aware git workflows via jira-cli: Conventional Commits with ticket suffix, worklogs and transitions, ticket writing (/ws-ticket), automatic Keep-a-Changelog updates, and PR creation via tea (Gitea)

plugins.name: ws-matt
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills (MIT, vendored) interlinked as a graph-engineered skill set: entry orchestrator nodes + worker discipline nodes, worker agents with structured output, omp edge-discipline rule. /ws-matt entry.

plugins.name: ws-project-hub
plugins.description: Multi-repo project hub: single source of truth for projects spanning multiple git repos (app, web, design, docs), managed via the consolidated ws-hub-* commands (init, status, repos, add-repo, describe, docs), with a role: docs product-docs sub-repo convention
